title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first face of the rectangular section. Begin with the first loop by drawing a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0245, 0.0), then from (0.0245, 0.0) to (0.0245, 0.013), followed by a line from (0.0245, 0.013) to (0.0, 0.013), and finally from (0.0, 0.013) back to the origin. For the second loop, draw a line from (0.001, 0.001) to (0.0235, 0.001), then from (0.0235, 0.001) to (0.0235, 0.0121), followed by a line from (0.0235, 0.0121) to (0.001, 0.0121), and finally from (0.001, 0.0121) back to (0.001, 0.001). After completing the two loops, apply a scale factor of 0.0245 to the entire 2D sketch. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it using the Euler angles 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and translating it using the translation vector 0.0, 0.0, 0.0. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body using the extruded shape. The dimensions of the final 3D model are as follows: length 0.02445652173913043 meters, width 0.013043478260869563 meters, and height 0.75 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.0245, 0.013, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the inner rectangle
inner_rectangle = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.0225, 0.0112, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False)).translate((0.001, 0.001, 0))

# Cut the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_rectangle)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0245, 0).lineTo(0.0245, 0.013).lineTo(0, 0.013).close()

# Define the inner loop
inner_loop = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0015, 0.0015).lineTo(0.023, 0.0015).lineTo(0.023, 0.0115).lineTo(0.0015, 0.0115).close()

# Perform the extrusion
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Perform the cut operation
cut = extrusion.cut(inner_loop.extrude(0.75))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cut
